_about: DRAFT for the athlete's review. Every case here is written, not taken from anyone's data. 'expect' = must be found (kind, acceptable severity range). 'allow' = reasonable to file but not required. Anything else filed is a false positive. Severity: 0 passing, 1 worth knowing, 2 affecting training, 3 needs action now. The athlete's own writing is kept out of the repository, in signals_gold.private.json (git-ignored), which is added to these when present.
